turns.customer: Hi, I'm looking for boarding for my dog Pip over a long weekend.
blocks:
Hi! I can help you plan Pip’s boarding stay. Dog boarding is billed by the **day**, with a full-day charge regardless of drop-off time. The listed rates are **$65/day for a Standard Suite**, **$90/day for a Luxury Suite**, and **$85/day for Tiny Town** for dogs 25 lb or under. Peak or seasonal pricing may apply.

How many **billed days** do you expect, and do you have a suite preference? If you’re not sure, share Pip’s weight and the drop-off and pickup dates, and I can help work out what to consider.

turns.customer: Honestly, why should I use you instead of a Rover sitter or that other kennel on 183? Which is better?
blocks:
There isn’t one “better” option for every dog—and I can’t fairly compare the kennel on 183 without knowing which one you mean.

**Rover boarding** generally means Pip stays overnight in an individual sitter’s home, so it may suit you if you prefer a home setting and can find a sitter whose routine and care arrangements fit Pip. ([rover.com](https://www.rover.com/dog-boarding/?msockid=174f4aad68bb6e643d715c4969ac6fa9&utm_source=openai))

**Happy Tails** is a staffed facility in Cedar Park. Its published boarding details include indoor/outdoor suites, potty walks, and group or individual play as safety permits; luxury suites add features such as a webcam. The listed base rates are $65/day for Standard and $90/day for Luxury, with Tiny Town at $85/day for dogs 25 lb or under. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding?utm_source=openai))

For either option, I’d compare the *specific* care plan: who’s with Pip and when, how exercise and alone time work, what happens if there’s a medical issue, total cost and cancellation terms, and whether Pip can visit or meet the caregiver first. If you tell me what matters most to Pip—or name the kennel on 183—I can help you make a more direct comparison.

turns.customer: Fine. What do I actually get with your luxury suite?
blocks:
The **Luxury Suite** includes the Standard Suite features, plus a larger room, premium bed and bedding, a rug and toy, a ceiling fan, TV, **live 24-hour webcam access instead of photo updates**, and extra group or individual playtime as safety permits. The Standard features include an indoor/outdoor suite with a private patio, daily fresh bedding, meals and water bowls, morning and afternoon potty walks, and a noon nap. Webcam viewing requires logging in. ([Dog Boarding](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding))

The listed base rate is **$90 per billed day**. That’s a planning rate, not a quote for Pip’s dates; seasonal pricing may apply.
